coverage_policy: All three arms use the same games and complete prior TEAM box-score histories. Incomplete player windows retain their actual game membership, emit null statistics plus explicit coverage indicators, and use medians fitted on TRAIN only for DEV selection and TRAIN+DEV for final fitting. Report all exclusions and missingness.
player_imputation: median; keep_empty_features=true; explicit missing/coverage features from source completeness; no target/test-fitted statistics
primary_comparison: DEV-selected richer arm (team or team_player) versus original fixed 18-feature booster on exactly the same TEST games.
capacity_control: All arms also use the same four-candidate DEV-only grid; report fixed original settings for each arm.
test_policy: Freeze feature definitions, candidates, selected richer arm, and fitted-model hashes before scoring TEST; no TEST-driven rerun or tuning.
test_exposure: 2025-26 season previously evaluated by original baseline and text pilots; this is an exploratory backtest, not a fresh confirmatory test.
availability_policy: No current-game injury/active-lineup feature: existing cutoff-audited injury sample is sparse; prior-game workload is not current availability.
